searched: Searched arXiv (Kimi k1.5 2501.12599, Kimi-VL 2504.07491, Kimi K2 2507.20534), the MoonshotAI GitHub repositories (Kimi-k1.5, Kimi-K2, Kimi-K3; cloned history in a scratch directory), the moonshotai Hugging Face account (model listing and commit APIs for Kimi-K2-Instruct, Kimi-K2-Thinking, Kimi-VL, Kimi-Linear, Kimi-Dev, Kimi-K2.5, K2.6, K3), the moonshot.cn homepage and the kimi.com Kimi K3 post (the Chinese-path URL served the same English text), and a web search for Moonshot safety frameworks. No Moonshot-published safety framework, commitment or safety-unit statement was located; the only safety text recorded is the K2 report’s red-teaming section. No primary filing documents Moonshot AI’s investors; reporting on backers was not used. Kimi Linear, Kimi-Dev, Kimi-Audio, Moonlight, K2.5, K2.6 and K2.7-Code releases were found on Hugging Face but left out for budget. Kimi K3 is not on arXiv; its report is a GitHub PDF. Web.archive.org was not tried (refuses connections here).
